title: A Viewer promoted to Editor (or an Editor demoted to Viewer) sees the page follow the new role without a reload: viewer attribute, bar and notice
steps: S1: From the repository root run the command in `run.cmd`.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok: the role store re-reads on the team-changed event and on coming back into sight, a new role reaches every listener, an older answer never overwrites a newer one, the <html> viewer attribute follows the role both ways, and a promotion shows the notice.
fence: Client role store of the chat input with a stubbed /api/sites; no server, no browser.

tests: refresh reads the door again with refresh, and a new role tells every listener
only the newest read writes: an older answer arriving last is dropped
the page reads the role again on the book-changed event and on coming back into sight
the viewer attribute on <html> follows the role both ways and goes on stop
the notice shows on a promotion, goes after its time, and goes at once on a demotion
